start_containers: start Docker containers using OneDockerService with retry logic and optional wait for completion
wait_for_containers_async: wait asynchronously for a list of containers to reach COMPLETED or FAILED status
get_containers_to_start: determine which container indices need to be started based on existing container failure status
get_pending_containers: merge newly started pending containers with existing containers replacing only failed ones
remove_finished_containers_from_containe: filter out finished containers from a list and return remaining pending container IDs
